items.item_text: Is around moving machinery: Yes
Is exposed to marked changes in temperature and/or humidity: Yes
Drives motorized equipment: Yes
Dust: Yes
Other: Ability to work in an outside environment during inclement weather and temperature extremes.
1 year of agricultural experience, or a demonstrated ability to operate light and/or non-complex agricultural equipment.

Under general supervision, spray weeds using various herbicides, apply pesticides and fertilizers in research orchards, vine and row crop plots. Plant, train, prune, and maintain tree (citrus, dates, etc.), row and vine crops; hoe weeds, transplant vegetables or tree crops, and thin row crops. Install and maintain various types of irrigation systems. Irrigate research plots according to the irrigation schedule. Assemble portable sprinkler irrigation pipe, install and maintain underground concrete and PVC pipelines. Operate spray rigs, self-propelled and tow type; small and medium-sized wheel tractors with attachments including roto chopper, spring-tooth, leveler, forklift, pickup trucks, flat-bed trucks, and backhoe. Operate equipment on a seasonal or infrequent basis to assist in brush or trash removal, and light hauling duties on station properties and miscellaneous brush or weed control. Maintenance and minor repair of equipment. (85% time)
Maintain various records regarding equipment, cultural operations, water usage and material applied to research plots. (10% time)
Performs other duties as assigned. (5% time)
Required to hold valid driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program.
Read/Comprehend: Occasionally

Ability to read, write and perform basic arithmetic calculations; one year of agricultural experience, or a demonstrated ability to operate light and/or non-complex agricultural equipment; and knowledge’s and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the position.
Basic knowledge of plant irrigation practices
Experience and knowledge are essential to the successful operation, installation, and repair of irrigation systems.
Strong general farming background.
Experience in planting, pruning, and maintaining rows, trees, and vine crops.
Ability to operate light and/or noncomplex agricultural equipment such as trucks, tractors, and miscellaneous farming equipment.
Ability to perform maintenance and minor repairs on farm equipment.
Demonstrated experience and skill in the use of hand and power tools used in the normal repair of irrigation equipment.
Ability to record time records and plot location information.
Ability to read, speak and understand English as well as perform basic arithmetic function and daily record keeping.
Knowledge in the application of fertilizers and pesticides.
